name: Las Cumbres Observatory 0.35 m (PlaneWave DeltaRho 350 with a QHY600 camera)
note: One of an identical fleet; the McDonald Observatory unit is the site here. The zero points are for camera sq30 (a Haleakalā unit); the other units are the same design.

obstructionDiameter.n: the diameter the paper subtracts as the central obscuration; the paper does not name it in words, so this is read from the formula

pixelScale.n: the paper calls it the projected pixel size

fullWell.n: the paper writes 64 kADU, about 44 ke-, limited by the 16-bit converter

filters.t: Sloan u', g', r', i', zs; Johnson-Cousins B, V; Pan-STARRS w; Baader Halpha, [O III], [S II]; Astrodon exoplanet (500 nm redpass)

zeroPoint.n: the paper words its zero points 'in units of log(e-/s)'; the values are magnitude zero points per electron per second (checked by the library's oracle o5); camera sq30
